features.contract: the x19 committee learners: 276 timeline bundle features + 27 ADS-B departure/neighbour features + 11 v19 features (314)

execution.hosts: a third lane with 4 threads on six Azure workers beside round A's two lanes (CPU only); tools/ctx_launch_lirf_design.sh

motivation: LIRF blends today: matched non-population 0.15 v9 + 0.55 LIRF tree + 0.30 ens_nnl; unmatched 0.50 / 0.25 / 0.25 (configs/adsb_rnn_v1.json v25_recipe). The strongest label-free LIRF signal found so far (v9/v10 campaigns) is the schedule relative to the previous arrival's in-block at the same stand, which is neighbour information the context tokens carry (same stand, arrival in-block). July 2026 has no LIRF ADS-B ground coverage, hence the no-ADS-B token ablation.

protocol.data: tools/run_adsb_ctx.py --fold design: fit on the seasonal fold's fit partition (2025-02..06, 08, 09) with LIRF non-population rows included, monitor on 2025-10 (same rows rule), write October predictions only. Same fit partition as the nnl development seeds' seasonal fold.
protocol.decision: GO for a declared development round (a LIRF context ensemble in v27's LIRF blends) if at 4 seeds the ctx_lirf mean's L2 blend at b = 0.3 is at least 1% below the nnl 4-seed blend on LIRF non-population rows with the paired-day interval below zero. The development round's variant is ctx_lirf_noadsb instead if, at 2 seeds each, it is no more than 0.5% worse than ctx_lirf on all LIRF non-population rows and better on the unmatched ones (July 2026's regime). Otherwise NO-GO.
protocol.never_read: No design run predicts, scores or reads a label of 2025-01, 2025-07, 2025-11, 2025-12 or the ranking months.

readings.L1: October LIRF non-population RMSE (all / matched / unmatched) of every run and of variant seed means, against the nnl mean of the same seed count
readings.L2: v9 blend on the same rows: (1 - b) x v9 + b x network for b in {0.25, 0.3, 0.5}, network = variant mean of n seeds or nnl mean of n seeds; paired-day 95% interval of (variant blend - nnl blend) at b = 0.3 (the v27 matched LIRF net weight)
readings.L3: descriptive: non-LIRF October RMSE of ctx_lirf against round-1 ctx at equal seeds (does fitting LIRF cost the other airports?)

protocol.references: nnl: the 16 development seeds' seasonal-fold October predictions (runs/adsb_nn2/nnl_s201..s216/seasonal/stop_predictions.parquet), taken in seed order for equal-count comparisons; v9: cross-fitted October (scratch/v24/2025-10.parquet, with the population flag); non-LIRF: the round-1 ctx design seeds (runs/adsb_ctx/design/ctx_s1..s6).

purpose: Round B design: a LIRF-inclusive context network. LIRF carries 11-45% of development SSE per recipe month (January 11%, July 45%, November 39%, December 29% of v26's development SSE; v27 leaves every LIRF row unchanged, so about one point more of v27's) and neither v27 nor round A touches it. The context network is fitted with LIRF's ordinary rows (fill population excluded, as nnl in configs/adsb_nn2_network_v1.json), to replace or join ens_nnl in v27's LIRF blends. October only, before any development fit or score of a LIRF context network.
